Bug_Title: SIC: Deadly embrace of non-static inner class and thread local (SIC_THREADLOCAL_DEADLY_EMBRACE)
Bug_Details:
This class is an inner class, but should probably be a static inner class.
  As it is, there is a serious danger of a deadly embrace between the inner class
  and the thread local in the outer class. Because the inner class isn't static,
  it retains a reference to the outer class.
  If the thread local contains a reference to an instance of the inner
  class, the inner and outer instance will both be reachable
  and not eligible for garbage collection.
Bug_Explanation: The non-static inner class 'InnerClass' retains a reference to the outer class 'DeadlyEmbrace'. As a result, the inner class instance and the outer class instance are not eligible for garbage collection together, causing a memory leak.
Trigger_Explanation: The test starts a new thread that creates an instance of the non-static inner class 'InnerClass'. This instance is then set as the value of the ThreadLocal 'threadLocal'. The ThreadLocal 'threadLocal' is accessible to the main thread through the'showBug' method. As a result, the instance of 'InnerClass' is kept alive by the thread, preventing it from being garbage collected, leading to a memory leak.
